notes.sowing: Sow {cm:1.3} deep around your last frost date, or start in modules 3 to 5 weeks ahead. Do not rush spring plantings: a cold spell after planting out often makes bok choy bolt. Late summer sowings for a fall crop bolt least.
notes.care: Keep the soil steadily moist, since dry soil and heat both trigger bolting. Cover young plants with fine netting or row cover against flea beetles. Plants manage with a few hours of sun but grow more slowly.
notes.harvest: Snip baby leaves from about 30 days, or cut whole heads at the base when full size. Harvest any plant that starts to send up a flower stem before the buds open.
